main.description: Chooses what the asking account hears of a repository, a pull or an issue, as the appview keeps it for that account alone: no record is written. A choice counts from when it is made, and choosing the level it has already keeps it as of then. Requires authentication: a service token, or the session cookie the pages' login sets, from the pages themselves.

errors.description: A subject that is no repository, pull or issue, a level it cannot take, or more choices than the appview keeps for one account.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No such repository the account can read, or this appview keeps no index.
errors.name: NotFound

level.description: For a repository: `all` it does, its `releases` alone, or `ignore` it. For a pull or an issue: `subscribed` to every comment, or `muted`. Either way, `participating` forgets the choice, so the account hears as its part in it says; but for the account's own repository, which it hears all of until it chooses, `participating` is kept as a choice.

subject.description: A repository's dev.knotless.repo record, or a dev.knotless.pull or dev.knotless.issue.
